tasks.title: Deploy FidelityEMatrix v1.6.0 (branch tip) to the TBC Anniversary client and WoW Forever when present; owner runs /fide terrain probe
steps: git -C D: idelity-repo fetch origin

If D: idelity-repo is on flash/wow-ematrix-polish with no new local commits: git -C D: idelity-repo merge --ff-only origin/claude/ematrix-depth (it is a fast-forward of 87ec1ff). If it is not a fast-forward, stop and report blocked with git status.
node D: idelity-repo	ools	est_ematrix_math.mjs (expect 12 passed, 0 failed)

Copy (do not mirror or delete) D: idelity-repoFidelityEMatrix* over D:World of Warcraft_anniversary_InterfaceAddOnsFidelityEMatrix : robocopy D: idelity-repoFidelityEMatrix "D:World of Warcraft_anniversary_InterfaceAddOnsFidelityEMatrix" /E (no /MIR, no /PURGE)

List the AddOnsFidelityEMatrix folder with sizes: it must hold EMatrix_Core.lua, EMatrix_Math.lua, EMatrix_World.lua, EMatrix_Terrain.lua, FidelityEMatrix.toc, DataEMatrix_Data_Azeroth.lua (1.2 MB) and Media with 6 .tga files (Wall_Gradient, Glass_Sheen, Reticle are new)

If D:\World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\ exists, robocopy the same addon folder there too (no /MIR): the addon picks the vanilla data set on a 1.x client by itself. Report whether that client exists and its version.

Then hand over to the owner for the in-game part: /reload, then the eight checks in RESUME.md section "EMatrix v1.2.0: Claude's depth pass" (diag light form, lens lattice faint, cursor-right slide and turn, backdrop world, anaglyph, errors). Set status blocked with blocked_on: "owner: /reload and run the RESUME.md EMatrix check list" until the owner reports; then write what the owner saw into output and set done.

Owner, after /reload (scene is on by itself): stand at the Northshire Abbey door, then paste the output of /fide terrain probe, /fide terrain status, /fide world status and /fide status. On v1.4.2 the scene showed only the character copy and no trees: the probe prints the position, tile, ground, camera, the first six placements with their screen positions, and how many models loaded or failed, which says exactly why.
report: The merge result (new HEAD) and the test summary line

After the owner check: the /fide diag SetLight form line, whether the slide/turn went the right way (and any /fide calibrate used), how the lens lattice and walls look, anaglyph result, any [Fidelity EMatrix Error] lines verbatim; for check 7 (/fide world on): the /fide world status actor count, whether the overlay models line up with the real units, and how the red/cyan pairs look near vs far; for check 8 (/fide terrain on): the /fide terrain status line, whether tree copies stand on the real trees, and which way they are off if not
The complete /fide status and /fide diag output, verbatim, plus what /fide overlay on showed

tasks.title: Laptop: set up webcam head tracking for FidelityEMatrix v1.6.0 (virtual gamepad)
steps: git -C D:\fidelity-repo fetch origin && git -C D:\fidelity-repo merge --ff-only origin/claude/ematrix-depth (then redeploy the addon folder as in H005; the addon is v1.6.0)
Read D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\README.md

OWNER-AUTHORISED (Piskriek, 2026-11-03): install the ViGEmBus driver yourself. Download only from the official release page https://github.com/nefarius/ViGEmBus/releases (latest ViGEmBus_*_x64.exe, publisher Nefarius Software Solutions e.U.). Before running it: Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the file must be Valid and name Nefarius; report the version and the signature line. Run the installer from an elevated prompt (if UAC asks on the laptop screen, the owner clicks it). Reboot only if the installer says so, and say so in the report. Then continue with the venv steps.
python -m venv D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack ; D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack\Scripts\pip install -r D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\requirements.txt
D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack\Scripts\python D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\check_pad.py (must print PASS; if XInput sees no device, the driver is missing or needs a reboot)

Find out which process holds the webcam (the fractal daemons): if the camera is free, run the tracker with --source 0; if a daemon owns it, find what it exposes (a folder of frames or an MJPEG stream) and use --source frames:<dir> or --source <url>. Report which.

Start the tracker and keep it running: D:\fidelity-repo\.venv-headtrack\Scripts\python D:\fidelity-repo\tools\headtrack\headtrack.py --show (sit normally for the 2 s calibration). Report its first console lines and the contents of tools\headtrack\head.json after 10 s.

Hand to the owner for the in-game part: /console GamePadEnable 1, /console GamePadCameraYawSpeed 0, /console GamePadCameraPitchSpeed 0, /fide eye probe while moving the head, /fide eye calibrate sitting normally, /fide eye source gamepad; then lean left/right and report whether the scene follows the head (and /fide eye output).
report: ViGEmBus installer version, its Authenticode signature line, and whether a reboot was needed
which source the tracker uses and why
the /fide eye probe line and whether the scene follows the head

steps: git -C D:\fidelity-repo fetch origin && git -C D:\fidelity-repo pull --ff-only origin main (expect main at or after ed2d8fe)

Find how the Apex and the density bridge are currently started (the running node.exe command lines; CLAUDE.md section 4 lists them as Task 1180 and the :5179 TV loop) and note the BRIDGE_ROOT / working directory each runs with
Restart the Apex (triad_369_process.mjs, or serve.mjs if that is what runs it) and the density bridge (density_bridge.mjs) the same way they were started, from the updated checkout
Wait 30 s, then run from D:\fidelity-repo: npm run --silent triad -- status, and: npm run --silent triad -- status --json

The full plain output of triad -- status (it now prints a Holon block with flows n/6 and one evidence line per flow)
The holon.evidence and holon.flows objects from the --json output (trim the rest)
